label: 认知起步：目标进入 Studio
source:
flowchart TB
  task([任务：带着现场问题]) --> studio[Ascend Studio：提炼目标]
  learn([学习：带着兴趣或目标]) --> studio
  studio --> context[任务卡：目标 / 环境 / 验收点]
  classDef intent fill:#f1f5ff,stroke:#8da4de,color:#293b5c,stroke-width:1.5px
  classDef studio fill:#eeeefe,stroke:#7776c8,color:#34345e,stroke-width:1.8px
  classDef output fill:#ffffff,stroke:#cdd7e5,color:#344256,stroke-width:1.5px
  class task,learn intent
  class studio studio
  class context output

label: 寻源：依据与学习目标
source:
flowchart TB
  need[现场线索 / 学习目标] --> agent[智能体：检索与筛选]
  agent --> official[官方文档 · v8.0]
  agent --> practice[最佳实践 · v2.1]
  agent --> community[社区经验 · v1.3]
  official --> scope[依据 + 版本 + 适用范围]
  practice --> scope
  community --> scope
  classDef context fill:#f6f1ff,stroke:#9a84d4,color:#42335f,stroke-width:1.5px
  classDef agent fill:#eaf8f6,stroke:#69aaa2,color:#285d59,stroke-width:1.8px
  classDef source fill:#ffffff,stroke:#d5ddeb,color:#39475b,stroke-width:1.35px
  class need context
  class agent agent
  class official,practice,community,scope source

label: 明确：目标成为可行动路径
source:
flowchart TB
  intent[任务线索 / 学习目标] --> studio[Studio 与用户一起梳理]
  studio --> prompt[可编辑 Prompt：范围 / 约束 / 步骤]
  studio --> path[学习路径：节点 / 顺序 / 验证]
  prompt <-->|补充与调整| path
  classDef context fill:#f1f5ff,stroke:#8da4de,color:#293b5c,stroke-width:1.5px
  classDef studio fill:#eeeefe,stroke:#7776c8,color:#34345e,stroke-width:1.8px
  classDef output fill:#ffffff,stroke:#cdd7e5,color:#344256,stroke-width:1.5px
  class intent context
  class studio studio
  class prompt,path output

label: 实践：运行、解释与再验证
source:
flowchart TB
  plan[代码 / 学习节点] --> env[开发环境：运行 / 练习]
  env --> result{返回结果}
  result -->|错误| explain[日志 + 图解：解释原因]
  result -->|通过| mastery[运行结果：理解检查]
  explain --> retry[调整参数：再次验证]
  retry --> env
  classDef context fill:#eef7fb,stroke:#7eaebe,color:#2d4a59,stroke-width:1.5px
  classDef env fill:#e9f6f5,stroke:#5faaa2,color:#28564f,stroke-width:1.8px
  classDef fail fill:#fff1ee,stroke:#d99688,color:#743f37,stroke-width:1.5px
  classDef pass fill:#eef8f1,stroke:#7eaf8c,color:#315743,stroke-width:1.5px
  class plan context
  class env env
  class explain,retry fail
  class mastery pass

label: 应用：把收获带入下一次实践
source:
flowchart TB
  task[任务实践] --> draft[社区草稿：环境 / 问题 / 修复]
  learn[学习实践] --> card[个人知识卡：笔记 / 图解 / 代码]
  draft --> knowledge[知识与社区：可检索复用]
  card --> knowledge
  knowledge --> next[回到下一次任务 / 学习]
  classDef task fill:#f1f5ff,stroke:#8da4de,color:#293b5c,stroke-width:1.5px
  classDef learn fill:#f6f1ff,stroke:#9a84d4,color:#42335f,stroke-width:1.5px
  classDef output fill:#ffffff,stroke:#d5ddeb,color:#39475b,stroke-width:1.35px
  classDef community fill:#edf7f0,stroke:#83ad8f,color:#345542,stroke-width:1.8px
  class task task
  class learn learn
  class draft,card output
  class knowledge,next community
